description: PQC-specific overlay codes that supplement NAICS 2022 sector codes and ISO 3166 country codes in Trust Engine applicability filtering

geography.label: Five Eyes Alliance
geography.rationale: Used for standards with Five Eyes joint guidance (e.g., CNSA 2.0 applicability)

geography.label: European Union
geography.rationale: ISO 3166-1 does not assign EU as a country code; used for EU-level directives

geography.label: Global / International
geography.rationale: Standards with no geographic restriction (IETF RFCs, ISO standards)

geography.label: Europe
geography.rationale: Standards and guidance addressed to Europe as a whole, the EU and the other European countries; members are the jurisdiction registry's Europe regions.

geography.label: Americas
geography.rationale: Standards and guidance addressed to North and South America; members are the jurisdiction registry's Americas region.

geography.label: Asia-Pacific
geography.rationale: Standards and guidance addressed to the Asia-Pacific region; members are the jurisdiction registry's Asia-Pacific region.

geography.label: Middle East & Africa
geography.rationale: Standards and guidance addressed to the Middle East and Africa; members are the jurisdiction registry's Middle East and Africa regions.

sectors.label: HSM / Cryptographic Hardware Vendor
sectors.rationale: NAICS 334413 covers semiconductors but not dedicated HSM vendors

sectors.label: Cloud Key Management Service Provider
sectors.rationale: NAICS 518210 (Data Processing / Hosting) is the closest standard code

roles.label: CISO / Security Executive
roles.rationale: NICE v2.2.0 OG-WRL-007 (Executive Cybersecurity Leadership) is closest; CISO is a more senior framing

roles.label: Cryptographic Engineer
roles.rationale: NICE v2.2.0 DD-WRL-003 (Secure Software Development) with cryptography specialization

roles.label: Security Architect
roles.rationale: NICE v2.2.0 DD-WRL-001 (Cybersecurity Architecture) direct match

roles.label: Cryptography Researcher
roles.rationale: NICE v2.2.0 DD-WRL-008 (Technology Research and Development) closest match for a research role

roles.label: Cryptographic Validation Engineer
roles.rationale: NICE v2.2.0 DD-WRL-007 (Systems Testing and Evaluation) closest match; no work role is specific to cryptographic-module validation

roles.label: Security Operations
roles.rationale: NICE v2.2.0 PD-WRL-001 (Defensive Cybersecurity) closest match for security operations

codes.label: Government Cryptographic Infrastructure
codes.description: Applies to government agencies and their contractors that manage classified or sensitive-but-unclassified cryptographic infrastructure subject to national PQC transition mandates (e.g., NSM-10, CNSA 2.0, BSI TR-02102).

codes.label: Critical Infrastructure Operator
codes.description: Applies to operators of critical infrastructure sectors (energy, water, transportation, communications, financial) that are subject to sector-specific PQC migration guidance from CISA, ENISA, or equivalent bodies.

codes.label: IoT and Embedded Systems Manufacturer
codes.description: Applies to manufacturers of IoT devices, embedded systems, and connected hardware where constrained compute environments limit PQC algorithm choices and long device lifetimes create harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure.

codes.label: Financial Settlement and Clearing
codes.description: Applies to financial market infrastructure (exchanges, CCPs, CSDs, payment systems) where long-term data integrity requirements and regulatory oversight create heightened PQC migration urgency.
